text:
ajay: quick dump from this morning's microruns — l4 / t4 / a10g across us-west1 + europe-west1. did embeddings (512, bsz=16) and small-chat (64 tokens, bsz=8). attaching summary below, long form notes after.

nina: nice — link to plots?

ajay: paste:```
Summary (throughput tokens/s per GPU, 512-emb / 64-chat):
- L4: embeddings 18.2k tps, small-chat 9.6k tps
- T4: embeddings 7.1k tps, small-chat 4.4k tps
- A10G: embeddings 14.5k tps, small-chat 11.2k tps
p50/p95 latencies (small-chat, single request):
- L4: p50 18ms, p95 42ms
- T4: p50 38ms, p95 120ms
- A10G: p50 16ms, p95 48ms
Cost per 1M tokens (rough, infra rate):
- L4: $7.8
- T4: $2.9
- A10G: $5.9
Notes: L4 wins for embeddings throughput/unit cost when batching is high; A10G gives the lowest single-request latency for small-chat; T4 is cheapest but needs more capacity to match throughput.```

sam: any quality/regression from quantized models?

ajay: ran nf4 + int8 (gptq style) on all three. embeddings cosine-drop <0.8% across nf4; int8 had ~1.6% drift for embeddings on T4 (likely kernel reorder). For small-chat: nf4 had occasional token flip on ~0.5% of prompts (simple chit-chat), int8 produced stalling on T4 in a few runs (workaround: use tok-allocator tweak).

marie: kernel choices? we should pin to flash-attn where available for latency-sensitive routes.

ajay: yes — config we used: L4 -> fused-attn+flash (triton 2.1), A10G -> flash-attn v2 fallback, T4 -> cuBLAS matmul paths + patched attention (higher p95). For production: recommend pin order: flash-attn -> fused-triton -> cuBLAS. Also enable KV-prefix cache for chat routes to cut avg tokens/generation.

marie: how about autoscaler and batching knobs?

ajay: test settings that matched these runs:```
# inference config snippet
batching: { max_batch_size: 64, batch_window_ms: 5 }
quant_profile: nf4
kernel_policy: ["flash-attn","fused-triton","cublas"]
autoscale: { min_replicas: 2, cpu_target: 60 }
```

bench-bot: automated: p50/p95 numbers logged to bench-db run_id=2026-03-15-17677; charts uploaded to: https://internal/bench/17677/pocket-compare

nina: region delta? eu had +18ms p95 on L4 and +25ms on A10G vs us-west; throughput similar but we saw 10% lower sustained throughput in europe under same VM type (networking/placement diff).

ajay: tl;dr recommendations: for embeddings-heavy workloads -> prefer L4 (nf4) with larger batching; for low-latency single-request chat -> A10G pinned to flash-attn; T4 -> cost-effective for large background batch jobs but avoid for latency-critical chat unless you add more replicas and pin kernels. Also watch quant int8 on T4 for small-chat quality issues.

sam: can you drop the raw CSV into the run and open a short PR for console docs? i'll review config recs.

ajay: yup will upload CSV + perf traces and open PR by EOD. :thumbsup:
